      Run more

      pi-dispatch canary --role planner --model openai/gpt-5 --flow fix --cap-usd '<cap-usd>' --count 1

      Replace <cap-usd> with the new experiment's total dollar cap before running. Canary supports first-party Anthropic or OpenAI on the local Docker venue. Run this command on the host. Its deployment lease holds every other start. One flow, at most 10 runs.

      History covers at most 30 days and 24 retained records. Missing history is never evidence of a free or successful canary.
